import os, json, base64, tomllib
from dotenv import load_dotenv
load_dotenv\('.env'\)

def role_of\(k\):
    if not k or k.count\('.'\) < 2:
        return 'NOT_A_JWT'
    p = k.split\('.'\)[1]
    p += '=' * \(-len\(p\) % 4\)
    return json.loads\(base64.urlsafe_b64decode\(p\)\).get\('role', 'no-role'\)

env_key = os.environ.get\('SUPABASE_KEY', ''\)
with open\('.streamlit/secrets.toml', 'rb'\) as f:
    sec = tomllib.load\(f\)
sec_key = sec.get\('SUPABASE_KEY', ''\)

print\('env SUPABASE_KEY role:', role_of\(env_key\)\)
print\('secrets.toml SUPABASE_KEY role:', role_of\(sec_key\)\)
print\('keys identical:', env_key == sec_key\)
print\('SUPABASE_URL present in env:', bool\(os.environ.get\('SUPABASE_URL'\)\)\)
")
